tool_input.command: $log = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'import-cursor-backfill.log'; if (Test-Path $log) { Get-Content $log -Tail 80 -Encoding UTF8 } else { 'no log' }; node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),os=require('os');const strip=s=>s&&s.charCodeAt(0)===0xfeff?s.slice(1):s;const tmp=os.tmpdir(),root=path.join('out','distilled-local','cursor');console.log('--- pending ---');for(const p of ['iHome2.0小程序','d-repository','i淮安公版','苏州市房地产监测V3']){let m=0;const src=path.join(root,p);if(fs.existsSync(src))for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json'))){try{m+=(JSON.parse(strip(fs.readFileSync(path.join(src,f),'utf8'))).memories||[]).length}catch(e){}}const df=path.join(tmp,'done-ov-cursor-'+p+'.json');let d=0;if(fs.existsSync(df))try{d=JSON.parse(strip(fs.readFileSync(df,'utf8'))).length}catch(e){}console.log(p+' pending='+(m-d)+' done='+d+'/'+m);}"

tool_input.description: V3 distill titles vs done set
tool_input.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),os=require('os');const strip=s=>s.charCodeAt(0)===0xfeff?s.slice(1):s;const src=path.join('out/distilled-local/cursor','苏州市房地产监测V3');const titles=[];for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json'))){const j=JSON.parse(strip(fs.readFileSync(path.join(src,f),'utf8')));for(const m of j.memories||[]) titles.push(m.title);}const done=new Set(JSON.parse(strip(fs.readFileSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'done-ov-cursor-苏州市房地产监测V3.json'),'utf8'))));const missing=titles.filter(t=>!done.has(t));console.log('mems',titles.length,'unique',new Set(titles).size,'done',done.size,'missing',missing.length);if(missing.length) console.log('sample',missing.slice(0,3));"
